name: OpenClaw
summary: Open-source personal AI assistant that runs on your own machine behind one Gateway and talks to you over WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, Discord, iMessage and 20+ other channels.
description:
A local **Gateway** is the control plane for sessions, tools, events and channel connections; a Control UI, CLI and TUI connect to it, and companion apps add voice, camera, screen and device actions. Models and agent harnesses (Claude, Codex, local models) are swappable plugins; tools, skills and plugins extend it, with skills and plugins published on [ClawHub](https://clawhub.ai). Install with `curl -fsSL https://openclaw.ai/install.sh | bash` or `npm install -g openclaw@latest`, then `openclaw onboard --install-daemon`.

**Security note from the README:** tools run on the host for the main session unless you configure sandboxing, and inbound messages should be treated as untrusted input. Developed by the OpenClaw Foundation, an independent 501(c)(3).

agent_access.notes: Docs pages are also served as Markdown via .md URLs or Accept: text/markdown.
